title: 第十九章 围局第二十章 协议
lines: 老五和老四的尸体是在第二天清晨被发现的。
青石岭的官道上，两匹马徘徊不前，嘶鸣声惊动了路过的商队。商队的护卫走近一看，脸色煞白——两具尸体，一具靠在山石上，一具倒在树下。血迹已经干了。
消息传到天阙宗时，祖破军正在后山密室中。
密室的门紧闭着，里面偶尔传出一丝微弱的灵力波动，像是什么东西在缓慢愈合。没有人知道他在里面做什么，也没有人敢问。自从城东仓库被炸后，宗主就很少出来了。有人说他受了伤，有人说他在炼化什么东西，也有人说他只是在避风头。
传话的弟子跪在密室门外，声音在发抖。
“宗主，出事了。”
沉默了很久。
“五爷和四爷……在青石岭被人杀了。”
密室中又是一阵沉默。
“谁干的？”
“不知道。现场没有留下任何痕迹。”
祖破军没有出声。老五，元婴中期。老四，元婴初期。两个元婴，配合了十几年。能杀他们的人，至少是元婴后期。
“老大呢？”
“已经在路上了。二爷和三爷也跟着。”
“让他们直接去华天酒楼。”祖破军的声音从密室中传出来，听不出情绪，“昊儿身边不能没有人。”
洛阳城，华天酒楼。
祖昊已经三天没有出门了。
城东仓库爆炸的消息传到他的耳朵里时，他正在喝酒。弟子说，有人在现场辨认出了少宗主的灵力残留。祖昊愣了很久，然后摔了酒杯。
“放屁！老子那天在别院！”
但没有人信他。天阙宗少宗主炸了城东的仓库——这件事不管是不是他干的，天阙宗都必须认。现场的灵力残留是真的。
祖破军知道，那批东西的主人不会善罢甘休。但他不能承认儿子被人利用了——承认了，就等于承认有人能假扮天阙宗少宗主而不被发现。这个口子一开，天阙宗的威信就全完了。更麻烦的是，那批东西的主人会怎么想？
祖昊不知道这些。他只知道，外面想杀他的人很多。
那个化神初期的护卫被调回去了，说是“另有任用”。祖昊骂了三天，但也只能骂。他爹的决定，他改变不了。
他在等。等宗门派人来保护他。
傍晚时分，三匹马从洛阳城东门进来。
前面那匹马上坐着一个五十出头的修士，面容阴鸷，眼窝深陷，穿着一身墨绿色的长袍。他的气息阴沉而潮湿，像深秋的雾——生肖冥蛇，五行属水。灵力浑厚，深不可测，至少元婴圆满。
天阙五雄，老大。
后面那匹马上坐着一个四十多岁的修士，身材魁梧，虎背熊腰，穿着一身玄色长袍。他的气息厚重如山——生肖蛮牛，五行属金。灵力凝实，沉稳有力，元婴后期。
天阙五雄，老二。
最后那匹马上坐着一个三十多岁的修士，面容清秀，眉目间带着一丝阴柔，穿着一身灰白色的长袍。他的气息飘忽不定——生肖魂羊，五行属木。元婴中期。
天阙五雄，老三。
三匹马在华天酒楼门口停下。老大翻身下马，抬头看了一眼二楼的窗户。
“少宗主在上面？”
门口的弟子连忙点头。
content_en:
The bodies of Lao Wu and Lao Si were discovered early the next morning.
On the official road in Qingshiling, two horses lingered, and their neighing alarmed the passing caravan. When the caravan guard came closer, his face turned pale. There were two corpses, one leaning on a rock and the other lying under a tree. The blood has dried.
When the news reached Tianque Sect, Zu Pojun was in the secret room in the back mountain.
The door of the secret room was closed tightly, and occasionally there was a faint fluctuation of spiritual power inside, as if something was slowly healing. No one knew what he was doing inside, and no one dared to ask. Ever since the warehouse in the east of the city was bombed, the sect leader rarely came out. Some said he was injured, some said he was refining something, and some said he was just avoiding the limelight.
The disciple who delivered the message knelt outside the secret room door, his voice trembling.
"Sect Master, something happened."
There was silence for a long time.
"Say."
"The fifth master and the fourth master...were killed in Qingshi Ridge."
There was another silence in the secret room.
"Who did it?"
"I don't know. There were no traces left at the scene."
Zu Pojun said nothing. Lao Wu, the middle stage of Nascent Soul. The fourth child, the early stage of Nascent Soul. The two Nascent Souls have worked together for more than ten years. The people who can kill them are at least in the late Nascent Soul stage.
"Where's the boss?"
"Already on the way. The second master and the third master are following."
"Let them go directly to Huatian Restaurant." Zu Pojun's voice came from the secret room, and his emotions could not be heard. "Hao'er can't live without someone around him."
"Yes."
——
Luoyang City, Huatian Restaurant.
Zu Hao has not gone out for three days.
He was drinking when the news of the explosion in the east city warehouse reached his ears. Disciples said that someone at the scene identified the remnants of the young sect master's spiritual power. Zu Hao was stunned for a long time, and then threw the wine glass.
"Fart! I was in another courtyard that day!"
But no one believed him. The young master of the Tianque Sect blew up the warehouse in the east of the city - whether he did it or not, the Tianque Sect must admit it. The spiritual remnants at the scene were real.
Zu Pojun knew that the owner of those things would not give up. But he couldn't admit that his son had been taken advantage of - admitting it would be equivalent to admitting that someone could pretend to be the young master of the Tianque Sect without being discovered. Once this hole is opened, the prestige of Tianque Sect will be completely destroyed. More troublingly, what would the owner of those items think?
Zu Hao didn't know this. All he knew was that there were many people out there who wanted to kill him.
The guard who was in the early stage of becoming a god was transferred back, saying that he had "other appointments." Zu Hao scolded him for three days, but he could only scold him. He couldn't change his father's decision.
He is waiting. Wait for the sect to send someone to protect him.
In the evening, three horses came in from the east gate of Luoyang City.
Sitting on the horse in front was a monk in his early fifties, with a sinister face and sunken eye sockets, wearing a dark green robe. His breath is gloomy and moist, like late autumn fog - his zodiac sign is Snake, and his five elements belong to water. The spiritual power is strong and unfathomable, at least the Nascent Soul is perfect.
Tianque Wuxiong, the boss.
Sitting on the horse behind was a monk in his forties, tall and muscular, wearing a black robe. His aura is as thick as a mountain - his zodiac sign is bull, and his five elements belong to gold. The spiritual power is solid, steady and powerful, in the late Nascent Soul stage.
The second among the five heroes of Tianque.
Sitting on the last horse was a monk in his thirties, with a delicate face and a hint of femininity in his brows, wearing a gray-white robe. His breath is erratic - his zodiac sign is soul sheep, and his five elements belong to wood. The middle stage of Nascent Soul.
Tianque Wuxiong, the third child.
Three horses stopped at the entrance of Huatian Restaurant. The boss got off his horse and looked up at the second floor window.
"Young Sect Leader is up there?"
The disciples at the door nodded quickly.
